positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Ownership Services:
- Brought serviceability and quality mindset to the team. Set up an appropriate CI pipeline for the third-party software analysis ingestion pipeline.
- Increased efficiency to report OSS usage in all Tableau products.
- Defining a governance model to safely ingest, audit, and use third-party software in all Tableau products. Collaborate with the Infrastructural and Security teams to provide a clean integration with build systems to ingest cleanly and to report violations (block-listing or vulnerabilities) regarding third-party software in all Tableau products.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Remote Presence - Developer Experience
- Expanding test coverage for P0 scenarios for Facebook Rooms.
- Unblocking P0 scenario testing for mobile configurations for Facebook Rooms.
- Tracking Remote Presence developer tools quality metrics and improvements.

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Manager for a 6 member diverse team with multiple levels of experience.
- Team founding member. Collaborated with company-wide leaders in multiple orgs and disciplines (security, legal, development, release) to define the company's guiding principles for third party governance.
- Hire and retain top quality talent for the company.
- Work with customers to identify high impact areas and provide focus to deliver customer value.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead improvements to reduce system's tech debt and complexity by migrating custom tools towards industry standard tools (gradle, docker, vault, AWS).
- Redesigned submission client to improve testability and test coverage (+30%) by applying appropriate design patterns (MVVM). Reduced bug regressions from 20% to 0%, and reduced MTTR by 80%.
- Redesigned the submission backend service to achieve: reduce data loss of events and snapshots from 3% to 0%, storage requirements reduction by 98.5%, service restoration speed by 98% (3 hours to 3 minutes), removed DB maintenance cost by moving from on prem LevelDB to AWS Aurora.
- Enabled monitoring and alerting (on prem via Zabbix, and on AWS via NewRelic and CloudWatch) to measure availability and performance.
- Developed, released, and maintained multiple front-end user features (React, Jsx, Sass).
- Enabled 0-downtime configuration changes.
- Maintained and improved build grid failure categorization service to identify and remediate reliabilty failures ("not my fault" failures) that hit dev productivity .

positions.title: SDE II
positions.description:
- Owner of Machine Imaging stack for onboarding new hardware to support cloud services.
- Tooling improvements for HA/DR scenarios for OneDrive to reduce MTTR of failed deployments.
- Participatetd in On-boarding of OneDrive to a modern build pipeline (build cloud parallelization).
- Designed, developed, and deployed Product wide solution for geo-political clean up.

positions.title: SDET II
positions.description:
Major accomplishments:
- Shipped multiple developer productivity features (Test Window, Code Lens) while being the main quality liaison and build ops for a team of 10 engineers. (Visual Studio)
- Developed a system for performance analysis that yielded actionable results within 2 hours of check-in. Co-authored a patent for Streamlined performance testing to turn unit tests into performance tests. (Visual Studio)
- Developed a tool to harvest test case data to measure MTTR and to categorize product issues vs test issues. (Visual Studio)

Shipped Office 2007, Windows Live Wave 3 Faily Safety, Windows 7, Visual Studio 2012, and Visual Studio 2013.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Delivered automation scripts to test new background file download functionality in Office 2007.
- Participated in bug hunting for a security feature.
